commands.command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; echo '--- BEFORE ---'; "$ADB" devices -l; echo '--- MDNS ---'; MDNS="$("$ADB" mdns services)"; printf '%s\n' "$MDNS"; ENDPOINT="$(printf '%s\n' "$MDNS" | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; test -n "$ENDPOINT"; echo WIFI_ENDPOINT=$ENDPOINT; echo '--- CONNECT ---'; "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT"; test "$("$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" get-state)" = device; printf 'MODEL='; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'; printf 'SERIALNO='; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r'; printf 'ANDROID_VERSION='; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'; printf 'WLAN_IP='; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell ip -4 addr show wlan0 | awk '/inet / {print $2; exit}' | tr -d '\r'; echo '--- AFTER ---'; "$ADB" devices -l
